generator_cmd:
truncate -s 256K gpt4k.img && printf 'label: gpt
label-id: 6E2A0F3C-...
start=6, size=10, type=L, name="boot4k"
start=20, size=30, type=L, name="data4k"
' | sfdisk --sector-size 4096 gpt4k.img && head -c 24576 (primary GPT only)
oracle_cmd: fdisk -l -x --sector-size 4096 gpt4k.img -> header lines 'First usable LBA'
